decisions.reason: The necessary propagation is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY updating its derivation_rule to the revised wider, more authoritative Hero V geometry.

The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY directly capturing the wider stance, substantial visual weight, and balance of confidence and restraint; the accent derivation change requires no additional Hero V state change.
The change concerns geometry inherited by the V system and É accent, not the deferred architectural E and L letterforms.
Revising the shared V geometry does not change the closing V's established smaller, subordinate prominence relative to the Hero V.
The source changes geometric proportions and presence, while the deferred champagne material treatment and its role remain unchanged.
The source does not address spacing or alter the deferred requirement that the full wordmark read as one unified mark.
The geometric direction change does not alter the independent obligation to include design rationale with review rounds.
